tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The desk: page background behind the panels and the header. Text on it: ink only (ink-muted fails 4.5:1 on light paper).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cardstock panels: the inspector, rail, drawer, popovers and cards. Text: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells cut into a panel: inputs, thumbnails, sheet previews, the inactive part of a segmented control.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: The cardboard sheet the room stands on (the 3D stage and the floor plan), lit by the stage lamp. Overlay controls on it sit on surface chips.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between sections and rows inside a panel. Decorative only, never a control edge.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, chips and the step numbers: 3:1 on surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and icons on paper, surface, surface-sunken and stage. Also the 2px edge of secondary buttons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, units, captions on surface, surface-sunken and primary-soft. Not on paper.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one main action per view: an ink sticker by day, caramel at night. Text on it: on-primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind info notices and hovered rows. Text: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: caramel
tokens.usage: Caramel tape: the selected tab, step, filter chip, segment and slot. Always with its caramel-edge lip. Text on it: on-caramel.

tokens.name: on-caramel
tokens.usage: Text and icons on caramel.

tokens.name: caramel-edge
tokens.usage: The 2px lip under a caramel fill, so the selected state reads at 3:1 against surface.

tokens.name: select
tokens.usage: Blue ballpoint: the selected piece's outline, the turn ring and handles, the front-back axis. The only cool colour. 3:1 on stage, surface and paper.

tokens.name: select-halo
tokens.usage: The halo drawn under select lines on the stage so they read on any room colour.

tokens.name: flute-shade
tokens.usage: Corrugated edge, the darker flute. Edges and the header strip only.

tokens.name: flute-face
tokens.usage: Corrugated edge, the lighter flute. Edges and the header strip only.

tokens.name: stitch
tokens.usage: Faint dashed stitching just inside a panel's edge. Decorative only.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: LED light only: bulbs, halos, the Light step, night mode. Never a button fill or text colour. Text on it: on-glow.

tokens.name: on-glow
tokens.usage: Text on a glow fill (the lights counter).

tokens.name: glow-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind lighting notices and the circuit card. Text: ink.

tokens.name: kraft
tokens.usage: Chipboard: material swatches, Mimi, illustration. Never text.

tokens.name: basswood
tokens.usage: Basswood: material swatches and illustration. Never text.

tokens.name: score
tokens.usage: Score and fold lines, snapping guides and the across-the-room axis. 3:1 on stage, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done states: calibrated, fits, all good. A plain card chip, always with the check icon and a word. Text on surface and success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Behind the All good chip and success notices. Text: ink or success.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs a look (amber, so it never reads as the brown success): thin joints, long cut times; the up axis. Always with the alert icon and a word. Text on surface, stage and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warning notices. Text: ink or warning.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Blocks a cut: overlaps, parts too big for the mat, unsupported blade; destructive actions. Always with an icon and a word. Text on surface and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger notices and the clash fill on the floor plan. Text: ink or danger.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, in blue ballpoint. 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

color.note: Kraft and cardstock: the page is a kraft desk, panels are thick cut-out card with a corrugated (flute) edge, the stage is a sheet of cardboard under a warm lamp. Light has no green or teal; the blue ballpoint (select) is the only cool colour, and it means selection and focus. Texture goes only on edges and backgrounds, never behind text.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Start screen and celebration moments only. One per screen.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The kit name in the header and step titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Inspector heading (the selected thing), card and dialog titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside the inspector and panels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Push a scrap of board into each slot.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: Shelves come before the second side.
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text and button labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Hints and captions under controls, in ink-muted.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Tiny uppercase section markers (set text-transform: uppercase in CSS). At most one per panel.

styles.name: measure
styles.usage: Every dimension, time and count: inputs with units, sheet sizes, LED leads. Tabular figures.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Headline numbers in the kit meter and circuit card.

spacing.note: 4px base. Stack panels in space-5, rows in space-3, label-to-input space-1.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to input, icon to its text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips, inside compact controls, between buttons in a group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows of fields; card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding; the stage gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections of the inspector; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; between major regions.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Start-screen rhythm and the finger-joint pitch in illustrations.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, segments, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, the stage, dialogs and the cut-sheet frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: the checks pill, the step indicator, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-cut-sm
tokens.usage: Hand-cut corners for chips, segments and small buttons. Slightly uneven, never more.

tokens.name: radius-cut-md
tokens.usage: Hand-cut corners for buttons, cards and notices.

tokens.name: radius-cut-lg
tokens.usage: Hand-cut corners for panels, the stage and dialogs.

shadow.note: Panels are thick card: they cast a soft drop shadow and show a corrugated lip. Floating things get shadow-float.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Panels (rail, inspector, drawer, cards) resting on the desk. Pair with the flute lip.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Popovers, the library drawer, toasts, dialogs, the dragged piece.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: Stickers and tape: the primary button, caramel tabs and chips, cards on hover.

layout.note: Fixed sizes of the app shell and controls.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: control-h-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons, segments and chips inside panels.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: The header with the kit name and the step nav.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: The left tool rail.

tokens.name: drawer-w
tokens.usage: The library drawer when open.

tokens.name: inspector-w
tokens.usage: The right inspector.
